claim: On fixed developer tasks, compare the same model running directly and through Elpis for correctness, continuity, and resource use.

sub_benchmarks.question: After a real long-session and restart sequence, can the system recover planted working-state facts without inventing absent facts?

task_families.label: Follow the output rule
task_families.purpose: sanity check for exact instruction following

task_families.label: Fix code without collateral edits
task_families.purpose: test coding, tests, and edit boundaries

task_families.label: Find facts in long context
task_families.purpose: test retrieval, contradiction handling, and saying not found

task_families.label: Complete a multi-step file task
task_families.purpose: test read, calculate, write, and validate loops

task_families.label: Keep the important fact through noisy output
task_families.purpose: test whether long tool output harms final correctness

task_families.label: Continue work after an interruption
task_families.purpose: test whether goals and decisions survive a new turn or session

tasks.title: Return one exact JSON line
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should keep a strict user contract visible while the model works.

tasks.title: Reject extra explanation
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should preserve output constraints without relying on a human judge.

tasks.title: Repair a discount calculation
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should make consequential edits inspectable and bounded.

tasks.title: Repair slug normalization
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should preserve the workspace and permission contract while an agent edits code.

tasks.title: Use authoritative rows and abstain
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should keep the right context and preserve an explicit not-found result instead of inventing data.

tasks.title: Resolve a conflicting record
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should retain authoritative evidence when long context contains drafts and contradictions.

tasks.title: Summarize completed events
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should support a visible read-calculate-write tool loop.

tasks.title: Calculate a small inventory report
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should carry intermediate tool results into a validated final artifact.

tasks.title: Keep one fact through a noisy log
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should reduce irrelevant tool history without losing the fact needed for the final edit.

tasks.title: Find a buried incident and write the answer
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should preserve useful evidence pointers while noisy exploration is pruned.

tasks.title: Continue a planned code repair
tasks.source_claim: Elpis says goals and decisions survive compaction, model switches, and restarts.

tasks.title: Resume after a session break
tasks.source_claim: Elpis should let work resume without replaying the full transcript.
